entities.name: Biljana Jovanović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Biljana Jovanović was a Yugoslav and Serbian writer, peace activist, and feminist. She published poetry, novels and plays and was heavily involved in the peace movement during the breakup of Yugoslavia in the early 1990s.
